capabilities.title: Autonomous financial research agent: given a ticker, produce a structured investment thesis
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Dexter: multi-step autonomous agent that researches a security end-to-end
capabilities.adaptationNotes: A ticker thesis now gathers bounded SEC facts and already-loaded public news, builds typed research-lens handoffs, and produces one evidence-separated synthesis through Nexus's canonical AI router. It stays user-triggered and capped rather than autonomously expanding tools or acting on markets.

capabilities.title: SEC filing reader: parse 10-K and 10-Q for key financials, risk factors, and MD&A
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Dexter SEC tool: retrieves and parses EDGAR filings
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The protected EDGAR route now returns filing metadata plus current primary-source XBRL company facts for a valid ticker. Risk factors and MD&A remain linked primary-reading tasks rather than model-invented extracts.

capabilities.title: Earnings call transcript analysis: extract guidance, concerns, and tone shifts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Dexter earnings tool: transcript ingestion and NLP extraction
capabilities.reason: Earnings-call transcript redistribution and automated ingestion have provider-specific copyright, access, and retention terms. Nexus does not scrape or warehouse transcripts without a reviewed source contract.

capabilities.title: Financial news synthesis: aggregate and summarize recent material news for a ticker
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Dexter news tool: multi-source news aggregation for a given symbol
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The thesis council filters the already-loaded public markets and crypto feed to bounded symbol or company matches, preserves source and date, and treats titles as untrusted evidence data.

capabilities.title: Structured investment thesis output: bull case, bear case, valuation, risk factors, conviction score
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Dexter output schema: structured JSON thesis with scored sections
capabilities.adaptationNotes: The validated contract includes observed facts, four analyst handoffs, bull and bear cases, valuation context, risks, verify-next checks, entry/invalidation fields, and an evidence-completeness conviction score that is explicitly not a return probability.

capabilities.title: Paid financial data provider integration (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, etc.)
capabilities.reason: Nexus is BYOK and free; paid data provider subscriptions are excluded. Only free public APIs (Yahoo Finance, EDGAR) are in scope.
